headline: Expanse and Shelf Grind On; Fisherman's Row Line Shifts
war_summary: Fisherman's Row now reads seven Warden squares to two Colonial, against five to three with one laid waste at the last filing; fighting there has logged thirty-nine base events in the day and three in the past two hours. Stlican Shelf has likewise tilted, four Warden squares against five Colonial, with Breaker Town alone accounting for thirty-four events. The Weathered Expanse remains the war's furnace: fifty-two events in twenty-four hours, three in two, and casualties running near 1,253 Colonial and 1,802 Warden an hour. Callahan's Passage, reported quiet in this edition's last dispatch, has stirred again with five events in two hours and twenty-one across the day, its rolling toll past 12,000 Colonial and 14,000 Warden. Linn Mercy reports Warden casualties near 893 an hour as Colonial banners cover all eleven squares there. Nevish Line stands seven Warden squares to one Colonial, its casualties still climbing fast. Of the fifty-three regions reported, six fly more than one colour; Colonial forces hold the great majority of the remainder.
